builds.name: Harsh Lesson ceiling
builds.summary: Harsh Lesson bonus is (5+.035 AD)% target max HP. High total AD and armor penetration serve one leap; tentacles and spirit transfer are separate damage.
builds.goal: Harsh Lesson bonus is (5+.035 AD)% target max HP. High total AD and armor penetration serve one leap; tentacles and spirit transfer are separate damage.
builds.hypothesis:
Illaoi's next Attack causes her to leap at the target, dealing an additional [(3 / 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5 + (0.035) × AD) × (0.01)] max Health physical damage. When she strikes, nearby Tentacles will Slam at the target.
Bloodthirster/Infinity Edge/Eclipse provide high AD; Grudge supplies armor penetration; Profane/Youmuu supply AD and lethality. Infinity Edge crit is not assumed to multiply this spell. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

builds.name: Tentacle Smash: physical mixed-scaling slam
builds.summary: Explore a high one Tentacle Smash slam result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high one Tentacle Smash slam result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: The source helper at level 18 and Q rank 5 is 1.3 times (180 + 1.1 total AD + 0.4 AP). AP scaling does not make the slam magic damage. High AD and physical penetration support the slam; compare one AP slot only after accounting for the weaker 0.4 coefficient. No phantom extra tentacle or spirit echo is included.
